judgments.reason: The candidate is the Pennsieve Discover "stim-seizures" record (doi:10.26275/toip-zio0) by the same authors. This NEMAR derivative repackages it, so it is another deposit of the same data.
The dataset README names this medRxiv preprint (Ojemann et al.) as the study whose processed data it repackages; the authors, patients and stim-seizure analyses match.
judgments.paper_title: Automated annotation of low-frequency stimulation-induced seizures uncovers seizure generating networks
